title: Decision Table — Unseasoned Shares and the Redemption Minimum on a Class H Preferred Stock Holding Still Taking Reinvested Dividends, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
How the unseasoned shares and the redemption minimum of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding combine rests on whether the holding is still taking reinvested dividends.

## Decision table

| A reinvested dividend entry dated within the last 3 whole months | Unseasoned shares compared with the redemption minimum | Redeemable share amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | At least the redemption minimum | The present shares less the unseasoned shares (the unseasoned shares stand as the minimum) |
| Yes | Below the redemption minimum | The present shares less the redemption minimum |
| No | Either | The present shares less both the unseasoned shares and the redemption minimum |

For a holding with a reinvested dividend entry dated within the last 3 whole months whose unseasoned shares are at least the redemption minimum, the unseasoned shares stand as the minimum and the redeemable share amount is the present shares less the unseasoned shares; for such a holding whose unseasoned shares are below the redemption minimum, the redeemable share amount is the present shares less the redemption minimum; for a holding with no reinvested dividend entry in that period, the present shares less both.

The 3 whole months are counted as whole calendar months back from today. Present shares are the holding's purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements.

## Worked lines (hypothetical holding, present shares 40,000.00)

| Reinvested dividend within 3 whole months | Unseasoned shares | Redemption minimum | Redeemable share amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 5,830.00 | 4,000.00 | 40,000.00 less 5,830.00 gives 34,170.00 |
| Yes | 600.00 | 1,000.00 | 40,000.00 less 1,000.00 gives 39,000.00 |
| No | 600.00 | 1,000.00 | 40,000.00 less 600.00 less 1,000.00 gives 38,400.00 |
| Yes | 4,000.00 | 4,000.00 | 40,000.00 less 4,000.00 gives 36,000.00 — equal counts as at least |
